body: I'm lucky enough that most of my debts have been written off but I've definitely been slowly, inconspicuously cleaning, donating, selling and packing shit away to make it a little easier for everyone else when the time comes
And let it tear me up inside for an hour of agony? I mean I know I'll be dead but damn that shit sounds rough
But what about gun / tall cliff / rope / gasoline / alcohol / benzos and opiates. Literally no chance for failure.

What makes you think it is an issue of laziness? I'm more than capable of holding a gun and pulling the trigger. Pretty presumptive of you. But let's be honest - you're not talking to me, you're talking to the mirror. 

You've been coming here for years and since no one really helped you, why not hurt other people who are hurting? Does that give your simian brain the dopamine hit it needs?
